about: FlyFF objects (objects.json) that we keep for now but will delete later. The maps (worlds/maps/import-map.mjs) leave them out: a floating object is left out, a tree or a leafy plant goes into the map's trees or plants, which the world draws with one of ours (recipe "trees" and "plants", documentation/worlds.md). Each name: why it is here.

floating.maflharo01: a big roof that floats over the Flarine start square: it hides the human
floating.maprsmcr01: big propellers that float over the Flarine squares: they hide the human

plants.macoprgr04: a FlyFF leafy plant, not in our style: our plant/leafy, made after it, takes its place
